#!/usr/bin/env bash
set -euo pipefail

if [ ! -d "src" ]; then
    exit 0
fi

while IFS= read -r src_dir; do
    if [ "$src_dir" = "src" ]; then
        test_dir="test"
    else
        test_dir="test/${src_dir#src/}"
    fi
    if [ ! -d "$test_dir" ]; then
        echo "Missing test directory: $test_dir"
        exit 1
    fi
done < <(find src -type d)

exit 0
